summary: Read-only investigation into why `/skill:continue` does not appear in the Gizmo composer for the Slapdash project. Found that Slapdash stores `continue` as a prompt template at `.pi/prompts/continue.md` (added 2026-09-02), but Gizmo's resource discovery only scans `.gizmo/prompts`, `.agents/prompts`, `.gizmo/skills`, and `.agents/skills` (established in commits 2252ec2 and 6027d33), and explicitly disables ambient Pi discovery via `noSkills`/`noPromptTemplates` (refactored in 4f6c17f). Even if discovered, prompts surface as `/continue`, not `/skill:continue`; only skills receive the `skill:` prefix (pi-session-factory.ts:188-201 and 253-260, feature added in bef2d39).
decisions: Conclusion framed as resource-convention mismatch: Slapdash uses project-local `.pi/prompts` while Gizmo requires `.gizmo/prompts` or `.agents/prompts` (no `.pi/prompts` entry in `resource-paths.ts:24-50`).
`/skill:continue` expectation deemed a category conflation: prompts render as `/continue`; only skills are prefixed `skill:` per `pi-session-factory.ts:253-260`.

UI filtering (Composer.svelte:46-51 and composer-actions.ts:82-99) ruled out as the likely cause because matching is case-insensitive substring on names/descriptions and would accept `skill:continue` if the command existed.
